cases.sentence: Пока Навуходоносор, царь Вавилона, все его войско и все царства, и народы империи, которой он правил, вели войну с Иерусалимом и всеми ___ , было к Иеремии слово Господне:
cases.explain: «окрестными городами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, with all his army, all the kingdoms of the earth that were under his dominion, and all the peoples, were fighting against Jerusalem and against all its cities, saying:

cases.sentence: Ты увидишь царя Вавилона ___, и он будет разговаривать с тобой лицом к лицу.
cases.explain: «собственными глазами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: You won’t escape out of his hand, but will surely be taken and delivered into his hand. Your eyes will see the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he will speak with you mouth to mouth. You will go to Babylon.” ’

cases.sentence: И пророк Иеремия пересказал все это царю Иудеи Цедекии в Иерусалиме, 7 когда войско царя Вавилона воевало с Иерусалимом и ___ Иудеи, которые еще держались, — с Лахишем и Азекой.
cases.explain: «другими городами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Then Jeremiah the prophet spoke all these words to Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,

cases.sentence: Я сказал: 14 «Каждый ___ всякий из вас должен освобождать своего соплеменника-еврея, который продал тебе себя.
cases.explain: «седьмой год» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says: ‘I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage, saying,

cases.sentence: Я сделаю вас ужасом для всех ___.
cases.explain: «земных царств» — after the preposition «для», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Therefore Yahweh says: “You have not listened to me, to proclaim liberty, every man to his brother, and every man to his neighbor. Behold, I proclaim to you a liberty,” says Yahweh, “to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine. I will make you be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.

cases.sentence: С теми, кто нарушил Мой завет и не выполнил условий завета, который они заключили предо Мной, Я поступлю так же, как с ___, которого они рассекли надвое и между частями которого прошли .
cases.explain: «молодым быком» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: I will give the men who have transgressed my covenant, who have not performed the words of the covenant which they made before me, when they cut the calf in two and passed between its parts:

cases.sentence: Их трупы станут пищей ___ и земному зверью.
cases.explain: «небесным птицам» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: the princes of Judah, the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, the priests, and all the people of the land, who passed between the parts of the calf;

cases.sentence: Их трупы станут пищей небесным птицам и ___.
cases.explain: «земному зверью» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: the princes of Judah, the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, the priests, and all the people of the land, who passed between the parts of the calf;

cases.explain: «необитаемой пустыней» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Behold, I will command,” says Yahweh, “and cause them to return to this city. They will fight against it, take it, and burn it with fire. I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.”
